name: code-review
description: code-review is a review suite for AI coding agents: the /simplify, /code-review and /security-review you know from Claude Code, rebuilt for ZCode and improved. Clean-context subagents that didn't write the change review your latest diff, parallel validators kill false positives before they reach you, and /deep-review runs the whole pipeline in one command. The commands you know, judging code they didn't write. For ZCode.
